decisions.reason: The ID Vault was launched with a dedicated press announcement and fits the identity-centric super-app strategy, though as a feature it could be folded into the broader platform.
The identity-bound wallet supports the payment pillar of the ecosystem, but it is only mentioned on the website and overlaps with the payment framework, so it may be merged or rebranded.
The NFC tag authenticator is a niche hardware-linked offering with only a mention on the website, but it complements the company's core authentication business at low cost.
The secure payment and wallet framework has its own page and is a core pillar of the super-app offering for financial clients.
The multi-service mobile app platform is the heart of the firm's strategic direction toward super apps and platform ecosystems.
The app shielding library builds on decades of application-security expertise, has its own page, and serves regulated customers on a standalone basis.
